title: Release Notes
summary: Added Memos 0.31 support, note pinning, and widget interactions, with improvements to lists, sharing, and display.
Known issue: App Lock does not work properly!
The macOS version has not passed review. Users who need installers for Apple platforms can obtain them by joining the QQ group.

contents: Added Memos 0.31 support for browsing, creating, and searching spaces
Added note pinning to display selected notes on mobile home and lock screens
Added support for checking off tasks directly in Android home screen widgets and for iOS Lock Screen Live Activities
Added biometric unlock on mobile devices (known issue: App Lock does not work properly)
Added tag-page memory: new notes created under a tag automatically include that tag
Improved list loading for long notes and added full and quick Markdown preview modes
Improved incremental note-list refreshes to reduce full-page flickering
Improved third-party sharing to protect editing drafts and provide setup guidance
Improved rendering on the Explore screen
Improved swipe-left shortcuts while keeping all actions in the More menu
Improved scaling of the Windows quick-input window on high-DPI displays
Fixed night mode in Android widgets
Fixed permission requests and local scheduling for reminder notifications on Apple platforms
Fixed WebDAV connection compatibility and discovery of local-library backups
